integrity: The theorem is proved analytically. The bundled numerical verifier is corroborative and is not used as a substitute for the all-parameter proof. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to \(N\ge7\) and the support \(\{0,\pm1,\pm3\}\); it does not classify general two-frequency or five-point supports on cyclic groups.
title: Exact Turan mass for the five-point support {0, ±1, ±3} on cyclic groups
